title: Successful login with valid credentials
description: Verify that a user can log in successfully using correct username and password and receives a valid JWT token.

steps.description: Navigate to the login page.
Enter valid username and password.
Click the login button.
Verify user is redirected to the dashboard.
Verify a JWT token is issued and stored.

title: Login failure with invalid credentials
description: Verify that login fails with invalid username or password and an appropriate error message is shown.

steps.description: Navigate to the login page.
Enter invalid username and/or password.
Click the login button.
Verify login is denied and error message is displayed.
Verify no JWT token is issued or stored.

title: JWT token refresh process verification
description: Verify that the JWT token can be refreshed automatically before expiration to maintain session.

steps.description: Log in with valid credentials to obtain JWT token.
Simulate token nearing expiration.
Perform an API call that triggers token refresh.
Verify a new valid JWT token is issued and stored.
Verify user session remains active without requiring re-login.

title: Role-based permission access control enforcement
description: Verify that users can access only the modules and actions allowed by their assigned roles and permissions.

steps.description: Log in as administrator.
Create a user and assign a limited set of permissions.
Log out.
Log in as the limited-permission user.
Attempt to access modules and features outside assigned permissions.
Verify access is denied and appropriate error or redirect is received.
Access modules within permission scope.
Verify access is granted and functionalities operate correctly.

title: Create, read, update and delete (CRUD) operations for user management
description: Verify all CRUD operations in the user management module including role assignment and validation errors.

steps.description: Log in as administrator.
Navigate to user management section.
Create a new user with valid data and assign roles.
Verify user creation success and new user appears in list.
Attempt to create user with missing mandatory fields.
Verify validation errors are displayed.
Update existing user details including role changes.
Verify updated details are saved and reflected.
Delete a user.
Verify user is removed from the list and backend.

title: Batch weighing process with multiple weighings and tare calculation
description: Verify the full weighing flow including adding multiple weighings with different tare types, automatic tare deduction, and correct calculations of net weights.

steps.description: Log in and navigate to shipping weights module.
Create a new batch/partida with valid metadata.
Register multiple weighings for the batch with different tare types (e.g., yute, nylon) and weights.
Verify automatic tare value is deducted correctly based on selected tare type.
Verify net weights for each weighing are calculated accurately.
Finalize the weighing process.
Verify total weight summation and batch summary are correct.
Generate PDF report for the batch.
Verify PDF report includes all registered weighings, tare, net weights and summary.

title: Cupping evaluation creation, scoring and approval
description: Verify the commercial cupping process including evaluation form, scoring system, approval workflow, and integration with lot approval.

steps.description: Log in and access the cupping system module.
Create a new cupping evaluation with valid coffee lot details.
Fill the cupping scoring form with valid scores.
Verify calculated scores and quality metrics update in real time.
Submit evaluation for approval.
Verify approval status is updated and lot marked as approved.
Attempt to approve an evaluation with incomplete scores.
Verify validation errors prevent approval.

title: Lot integration flow with approved cupping selection
description: Verify the process to create an integration of lots selecting only approved cupping evaluations, automatic quintal calculation, and client/destination data input.

steps.description: Log in and go to lot integration module.
Attempt to select lots that have not been approved in cupping evaluation.
Verify unapproved lots are not selectable.
Select one or more approved lots.
Enter client and destination details.
Verify quintal calculation sum is correct and matches selected lots.
Confirm and create the integration.
Verify integration appears in the list with correct details.

title: Real-time dashboard metrics and temperature monitoring
description: Verify that the dashboard loads real-time metrics correctly, including temperature sensor data, active weighing card, and updates via WebSocket.

steps.description: Log in and open the dashboard.
Verify all real-time metric cards (e.g., active lots, weights) are displayed.
Verify temperature graphs render current sensor data.
Simulate live sensor temperature updates via WebSocket.
Verify dashboard updates temperature graphs dynamically without page reload.

title: Temperature sensor alerts and visualization modes
description: Verify that temperature sensor monitoring supports alert configuration, alert triggering, and toggles between compact and expanded views.

steps.description: Log in and navigate to temperature monitoring module.
Configure a temperature alert for a sensor threshold.
Simulate sensor temperature crossing the alert threshold.
Verify alert is triggered and notification appears.
Switch between compact and expanded visualization modes.
Verify UI updates accordingly and all sensor data is visible.

title: Fermentation tank management with monitoring and simulation
description: Verify the fermentation module allows monitoring and simulating volume changes, temperature, and pH levels, with real-time updates and alerts.

steps.description: Log in and access fermentation control module.
Monitor current volumes, temperatures, and pH levels of fermentation tanks.
Verify displayed data matches backend records.
Simulate changes to volume or pH.
Verify simulation updates are reflected in the UI immediately.
Check alerts for critical fermentation conditions.
Verify alerts trigger properly and notifications show.

title: Report generation with filters and PDF preview functionality
description: Verify that users can generate PDF reports applying various filters, preview reports before download, and see 'New' tags on recent reports.

steps.description: Log in and navigate to the reports module.
Apply different filters to search reports (date, type, status).
Verify filtered reports update accordingly.
Select a report and open preview.
Verify the PDF preview loads correctly and includes all expected data.
Verify recent reports are marked with a 'New' tag.
Download the generated PDF report.
Verify the downloaded PDF content matches the preview.

title: Notifications system functionality and user feedback
description: Verify that toast notifications appear for system feedback and real-time alerts, and that notification settings can be configured.

steps.description: Log in to the application.
Perform actions that trigger toast notifications (e.g., successful save, error).
Verify that notifications appear with correct messages and disappear after timeout.
Navigate to notification settings.
Modify notification preferences.
Verify changes take effect and notifications behave accordingly.

title: WebSocket real-time update for batch status
description: Verify that changes to batch statuses are pushed in real-time to connected clients via WebSocket without manual reload.

steps.description: Log in and open the batch management or dashboard page.
Using a different client or backend simulation, change the status of a batch.
Verify the status update is immediately reflected in the UI via WebSocket.

title: Performance validation: load times and bundle size
description: Verify the application loads within 3 seconds on typical hardware and the main bundle size is under 500KB without degradation of functionalities.

steps.description: Clear browser cache and reload the application.
Verify initial page load time is less than 3 seconds.
Use browser dev tools to verify bundle size does not exceed 500KB.
Perform critical flows like login, navigation, and report generation.
Verify no performance degradation or delays during usage.

title: Form validation and error handling in shipment weight creation
description: Verify all form fields have proper validation and error messages during creation of shipment weight batches.

steps.description: Navigate to shipment weights module.
Attempt to submit new batch form with empty required fields.
Verify appropriate validation messages appear for required fields.
Input invalid data types (e.g., text in weight fields).
Verify validation errors prevent form submission.
Input valid data and submit form.
Verify batch is created successfully without errors.

title: Handling expired JWT token access attempts
description: Verify that when a JWT token expires the application properly logs out the user or triggers token refresh flow and denies unauthorized access.

steps.description: Log in and obtain JWT token.
Simulate JWT token expiration.
Attempt to access a protected resource.
Verify that the application either refreshes the token transparently or logs out the user and redirects to login.
Verify that no unauthorized data is accessible.

title: Verify that system handles backend errors gracefully
description: Verify that when backend services return errors (e.g., 500, 404) the frontend shows meaningful error messages and does not crash.

steps.description: Simulate backend server error for user list API.
Navigate to user management module.
Verify user is shown an appropriate error notification.
Verify UI remains responsive and no unhandled exceptions occur.

title: Validate integration of client and destination data during lot integration
description: Verify that client and destination inputs during lot integration are required, validated and saved properly.

steps.description: Navigate to lot integration module.
Select one or more approved lots.
Attempt to submit integration without entering client and destination.
Verify validation errors are shown for missing client/destination.
Enter valid client and destination details.
Submit the integration.
Verify data is saved and integration details contain correct client and destination.

title: Verify logout functionality and session cleanup
description: Verify that the user can successfully log out and that all session tokens and data are cleared.

steps.description: Log in with valid credentials.
Click the logout button.
Verify the user is redirected to the login page.
Verify JWT tokens and session storage data are cleared.
Try to navigate to a protected route.
Verify access is denied and user is redirected to login.
